text:
Diane: Quick check — is everyone on track for the dep rollforward & lockfile bump for the 0.9.0 cut? I want to avoid last-minute submodule churn during the freeze.

Alex: On my side I finished the golang vendor sweep, pushed a branch: `deps/gomod-rollup-0.9.0`. Needs a quick review for the syscall shim change.

Tanner: I pulled that branch, ran `make test-unit` and got one flake in `pkg/kv` unrelated to deps. LGTM apart from the flake.

Jia: Submodule update for `third_party/onnx` is still pending — pinged the external maintainer this morning. Expecting a response by EOD.

Diane: Thanks — sequencing question: should we merge golang vendor first, then the onnx submodule, or the opposite? We need a clean lockfile after both.

Alex: Prefer vendor first so CI can capture the transitive go.sum changes. After that, submodule merge + `git submodule update --init --recursive` then regenerate the lockfile.

Tanner: Agreed. Also we should run the vendor-lockfile CI job locally before merge:
```bash
# run in container
./scripts/vendor-lock-verify.sh
./scripts/run-ci-dryrun.sh --job=vendor-lockfile
```
That catches the checksum drift we saw last release.

OpsBot: CI: vendor-lockfile dry-run queued by Tanner (job id 87922). :hourglass: 

Diane: Nice. Alex, can you queue the dry-run once you merge? I'll hold the release branch cutoff until we confirm the lockfile job passes.

Alex: Will do. Planning to merge in ~30m after fixing the flake. I'll add a short PR description with the `go.sum` delta and a note for the changelog team.

Jia: If maintainer doesn't reply, I can vendor a pinned tarball into `third_party/onnx` as fallback and open a follow-up PR post-cutover. Prefer upstream but fallback ready.

Leo: Heads up — release infra will block merges 10m before cutoff. So aim to finish merges by `2113344600` to be safe.

Diane: Good call. I'll nudge changelog for a small entry and mark the dep bumps under "Infrastructure".

OpsBot: CI: vendor-lockfile dry-run (job id 87922) succeeded. :white_check_mark: Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/87922

Tanner: :+1: If Alex merges now, can someone run `./scripts/rebuild-locks.sh` and push the updated lockfile to the release branch?

Alex: Merged. Rebuilding locks now and pushing to `release/0.9.0`.

Diane: Thanks all — once locks are pushed I'll do a final smoke on canary and then remove the freeze hold. :shipit: 

Leo: Noted, will watch the canary window.

Alex: Lockfile updated and pushed. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/deps/pulls/432

Jia: Awesome — I still have the onnx follow-up if upstream stalls.

Diane: Perfect. Closing the loop here; great coordination.
